messages.subject: How to launch shiny server ?
parts:
Hi,

I installed few weeks ago a shiny server.
I was unable to launch it with all command line I found in the manual.

sudo systemctl start shiny-server
sudo start shiny-server
sudo /sbin/service shiny-server start

My linux is a Mint 17 Rebecca, based on an Ubuntu 14.04 so the right command should be :
sudo start shiny-server
but I have this error :
start: Unknown job: shiny-server

The manual says for Ubuntu 12.04+ that there is a /etc/init/shiny-server.conf file but it doenst exist on my Linux Mint.
The only way I found is to do :
sudo nohup shiny-server
and it works...
but with this command I cant do a "reload" or a "restart", I need to kill the nohup process and launch it again.

Any advice ?
Why the "official" start command doesnt work ?
thanx

messages.author: 83f04c2ac04d41cd
messages.subject: Re: How to launch shiny server ?
parts:
Auto reply !
I found a solution, I explain it here, maybe it will help somebody in the future...
I found a link for the shini-server.conf file here :
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/wiki/Building-Shiny-Server-from-Source

Here is the command line to download this file :
sudo wget https://raw.github.com/rstudio/shiny-server/master/config/upstart/shiny-server.conf -O /etc/init/shiny-server.conf

Then I add this line after the description line of the shiny-server.conf file because some UTF8 character were not understood :

env LANG=en_US.UTF-8

And now the "sudo start shiny-server" command line works fine...
Hope this help
